definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to mean not doing something properly or adequately.

examples.japanese: {碌|ろく}に{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
{碌|ろく}に{説明|せつめい}もしないで{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: He left without even explaining properly.

notes:
GRAMMAR NOTE:
{碌|ろく}に is almost always used with NEGATIVE forms:
- {碌|ろく}に〜ない (doesn't do properly)
- {碌|ろく}に〜できない (can't do properly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {碌|ろく}に{食|た}べていない: haven't eaten properly
- {碌|ろく}に{寝|ね}ていない: haven't slept properly
- {碌|ろく}に{話|はな}せない: can't speak properly
- {碌|ろく}に{知|し}らない: don't really know

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as ろくに.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ちゃんと〜ない: don't do properly
- まともに〜ない: don't do decently
